articleTitle: Bridgeless PFC Rectifier for Single Stage Resonant Converter with Closed Loop and Improved Dynamic Response
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Power factor correction is an important phenomenon to improve the power quality on the grid connected systems. Power factor correction is predominant to comply with the harmonic standard IEC 1000-3-2. A single stage resonant converter with bridgeless PFC rectifier is proposed. The resonant converter is operated at high frequency by using a LC tank circuit to control the switching frequency. The proposed resonant converter along with voltage doubler and cascaded filter connected to the circuit will increase the output. The output power and output voltage is increased, power factor is improved, ripple voltage is decreased and reduced production cost due to the less number of switches. To achieve power factor correction with high frequency isolation and regulate constant output voltage at high line voltage with reduced number of switches, bridgeless single stage topology is proposed along with a closed loop and improved dynamic response.

articleTitle: Integrity Auditing with Attribute based ECMRSA Algorithm for Cloud Data Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a vast area within which large amounts of data are exchanged through cloud services and has fully grown with its on-demand technology. Due to these versatile cloud services, sensitive data will be stored on cloud storage servers and it is also used to dynamically control a number of problems: security, privacy, data privacy, data sharing, and integrity across cloud servers. Moreover, the legitimacy and control of data access should be maintained in this extended environment. So, one of the most important concepts of cryptographic techniques in cloud computing environment is Attribute Based Encryption (ABE). In this research work, data auditing or integrity checking is considered as an area of concern for securing th cloud storage. In data auditing approach, an auditor inspects and verifies the data file integrity without having any knowledge about the content of file and sends the verification report to the data owner. In this research, Elliptical Curve Modified RSA (ECMRSA) is proposed along with Modified MD5 algorithm which is used for attribute-based cloud data integrity verification, in which data user or owner uploads their encrypted data files at cloud data server and send the auditing request to the Third-Party Auditor (TPA) for verification of their data files. The Third-Party Auditor (TPA) challenges the data server for ensuring the integrity of data files on behalf of the data owners. After verification of integrity of data file auditor sends the audit report to the owner. The proposed algorithm integrates the auditing scheme with public key encryption with homomorphic algorithm which generates digital signature or hash values of data files on encrypted files. The result analysis is performed on time complexity by evaluating encryption time, GenProof time and VerifyProof Time and achieved improvement in resolving time complexity as compared to existing techiques.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection using ensemble deep Learning and Individual Channel Training
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: One of the commonly found medical conditions in people with type 1 or 2 diabetes is Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). It is mostly asymptomatic in its early stages and can lead to both central and side vision loss if left untreated. The five stages of this disease include normal (no DR), mild stage non-proliferative DR, moderate stage non-proliferative DR, severe stage non-proliferative DR, and proliferative DR. This condition is generally diagnosed by a highly trained ophthalmologist by examining the retinal images of the patients. But the medical image analysis by humans can be prone to perceptual and cognitive errors. On the other hand, deep learning has proven to be successful in medical image analysis and medical image segmentation in the last few decades. There are already many deep learning-based computer vision techniques that are available for DR detection using fundus retinal images. But most of them don't classify all the stages of DR accurately. The proposed method uses an ensemble model of five deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) trained on the EyePACS dataset images from Kaggle. Each channel of the image (Red, Green, Blue) is fed separately to all the models and the effect of individual channel on the result is analyzed. The proposed method performs better in classifying all the stages than most of the existing methods that use the same dataset.

articleTitle: Study of Effective Feature Combination for Fault Diagnosis of Bearings in Motors
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Condition monitoring for bearing faults is remaining more vital in the present scenario. This study presents a simple approach for diagnosing various bearing faults of induction motor, which uses effective statistical time domain features. The statistical time domain features like mean absolute value, zero crossing, waveform length, slope sign changes, simple sign integral and Willison amplitude are considered. The performance of features is studied with 6 feature ensembles (FEs) to identify the effective FE for fault diagnosis in the induction motor. This identification is based on the classifications that are performed by using linear discriminant analysis (LDA), naïve Bayes (NB), support vector machine (SVM) and logistic model tree (LMT) classifiers. Each feature ensemble is investigated for 5 datasets derived from a bench mark database for a maximum of 48 faulty conditions. The results indicate the FE constituting six features with SVM classifier outperforms other fault diagnosis techniques.

articleTitle: Database Forensics and Security Measures to Defend from Cyber Threats
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the present technology, users are generating huge data by using various applications based on the usage data is transferred to database. Database technology provides an efficient, easy and secured procedures for managing the data and information systematically. All the operations of data manipulation and maintenance are done by using Database Management System (DBMS) with Computer Networks which has become a powerful medium for fast information exchange and access. Ensuring security of the database is very a critical issue for any organization. Mainly security threats include any action to deny, exploit and corrupt or destroy the information by attackers. The systems have to be defended from various security threats by adopting proper security measures and techniques.The need of Database Forensics is increasing for investigating the cyber threats and database level attacks. Database forensics is becoming an important field now a days, which can be used to identify, detect, acquire, analyze cyber-attacks in the databases and its related systems. It is also required to make suitable readiness for cybercrime investigation team at organizational level to make at least preliminary level investigations. This paper briefly discusses about the database forensics and its security measures.

articleTitle: Innovation of an AI Classifier using different classification techniques to Predict the Placement Matrix of a University
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence is one of the most critical fields of Computer Applications. Over the years, Artificial Intelligence has been used to develop machines that exhibit traits of a human mind, such as learning and problem solving. This research paper presents a novel AI classifier that has been built by using different classification techniques. The idea is to apply the AI classifier on the records of students at a Placement Drive, and to predict their status of securing a placement at the Drive. This approach has been implemented and tested to show a high accuracy level in forecasting the results. Our approach has greatly aroused the curiosity to carry out further investigation and build such AI classifiers.

articleTitle: Seismic Image Pattern Analysis Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Seismic wave is the wave of energy that travels via the earth as a consequence of an earthquake or a volcano that occurs with low-frequency acoustic energy. By analyzing the Seismic earthquake patterns it is possible to find whether the earthquake will occur or not. In this project, the seismic data are analyzed by a Fuzzy Logic Controller. But the seismic data are affected by some unwanted artifacts. The de-noising method has the capacity to reduce the artifacts. Here the Contourlet transforms scheme gives better noise suppression in seismic images and the signal to noise ratio is improved. Further, the de-noised seismic image is segmented using Wavelet transforms for feature extraction. The extracted features can be analyzed by fuzzy Logic Controller which shows whether the seismic image is normal or abnormal. This analysis gives better results in the earthquake analysis and also in the construction of sensitive power plants.

articleTitle: A Novel Non Invasive Myocardial Infarction Vigilant System by using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In recent years, the number of patients suffering from cardiac diseases has increased at an alarming rate. Cardio related ailments are the prime cause of large death losses in most of the world. Accurate classification of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals can play a pivotal role in the diagnosis of heart disease. Human life can be saved if the disease is diagnosed at an early stage. The most common reason for the delay in treatment is patient unawareness. This calls for the use of highly sophisticated techniques providing quick and accurate results. This article recommends a non-invasive technique based on electrocardiogram signal analysis for detecting anomalies. Daubechies wavelet decomposition using 10 decomposition levels is used for denoising the ECG signal by dropping the noise coefficients. The proposed algorithm is used to detect ST-segment deviation from the isoelectric line which is the major cause of myocardial infarction. A Raspberry Pi running the algorithm sends AT commands to the GSM module to call for emergency help and send the GPS location via an SMS, in case a heart attack is detected. The purpose of this technique is to bridge the delay between the onset of heart attack symptoms and the arrival of medical aid. The accuracy of the system was found to be 95.23%.

articleTitle: An Efficient Use of SVM and QDA Algorithms on EPG Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The children diagnosed with hearing disabilities will lack the ability to recognize a word or sentence when it is orated. The Computer aided language learning system will remain as a boon for the children ith hearing impairment. The solution for this challenge is articulatory speech learning that has been performed by using Electropalatography(EPG) methodology, which is usually a task based language learning. The dataset combines speech and EPG of English vowels and consonants. Different statistical classifiers are investigated to recognize the vowel of electropalatography signals. The support vector machine, quadratic discriminate analysis algorithms and Linear discriminate analysis are used to classify the vowels and consonents. SVM and QDA Algorithms have been implemented to analyze the articulatory synthesis and speech synthesis, which will together decide the intonation contour of the speech utterances and tongue gestures.

articleTitle: Human Machine Interface Wheel Chair by using Wi-Fi Communication for Disabled Person
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The truly tested individuals are facing the challenges in strolling due to the disease, injury, or inability. Wheelchair offers them portability with the ability to enhance their quality of lives. The individual gives their voice through the android versatile and further the voice will get transformed into content. Then, the yield will be given to the small scale controller. This framework development is controlled by utilizing Bluetooth module with the help of servo engines. This proposed framework has a battery controlled wheelchair with servo engines. Moreover, the existing joystick-based framework should also get appended to the current framework. This framework remains straight forward and effective to disentangle the matter of truly tested individuals and furthermore, it remains as the least difficult usefulness with increased straight forwardness and minimal effort.

articleTitle: Realization of Metamutator using Dual Output Operational Transconductance Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper dispenses a metamutator circuit using Dual-Output Operational Transconductance Amplifier (DO-OTA) and is used to emulate a memristor. The proposed design makes use of two DO-OTAs. Memristor emulation is made possible by terminating three ports of the metamutator with non-linear resistor, capacitor and inductor. The metamutator is realized using behavioral VCCS macro model of DO-OTA and simulated for design values to verify the functionality using LTspice. The simulation results involve verifying the port relations of metamutator along with the V-I plot of the memristor and Monte Carlo plots. The pinched hysteresis plot confirms the emulation of memristor.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Separately Excited DC Motor with Wavelet Neural Network based Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The direct current motors are used in various applications such as defence, industries, robotics, which are the major power consumers. The optimal control of input parameters can decrease the power consumption and enhance the performance, reliability and life span of these machines. Although the separately excited DC motors provides constant speed output which is stimulated to the variations and unpredictability in inputs such as presences of nonlinearities such as saturation, friction and noise propagation along the series of unit processes degrade its performance. Thus optimal controlling of the parameters through the motor control unit is required to achieve smooth operation. This article is applied to the Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) based controller which uses the wavelet transforms as the activation function. This helps in continuous training and optimization of the controller parameters with minimum time duration. The different controllers such as proportional-integral, NN based proportional-integral-derivative, WNN based proportional-integral-derivative with filter, WNN based proportional-integral-proportional-derivative (WNN-PIPD) are compared in terms of rise time, maximum overshoot, steady state error etc. The inherent approximation capability and learning abilities of the proposed WNN-PIPD controller improve the degree of tolerance and adaptability concerning other controllers.

articleTitle: A survey on Electromagnetic Radiation based Remote Sensing Applications to Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Remote sensing is the process of acquiring information on Earth's terrestrial and aquatic surfaces through reflected electromagnetic energy. The channels that handle the sensor are called platforms that include ground-based, aircrafts and satellites. Remote sensing application includes agriculture, forestry, environmental monitoring, soil degradation, oceanography, geology, etc. The tools such as panchromatic sensors (PANs), multispectral sensors and hyper spectral sensors are used because they find out the chemical and physical composition of objects. This paper gives a summary of remote sensing, their species and applications that encompass agriculture in various disciplines.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm based Pressure Management Technique for Leakage reduction in the water Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Leakages in water networks depends on its operating pressure. Hence by removing excess pressure from the water networks leakages can be reduced by an extent. A pressure management technique is presented in the research paper for leakage control as well as for removing pressure deficiency in East Zone WDS of Nagpur City, India as a case study. Depending upon the demand variation, variable speed pump is increase or decrease the water flow in WDS which can eliminate pressure deficiency and can reduce surplus pressure during higher and lower demand respectively. Pressure reducing value is utilized for further pressure reduction of remaining excess pressure for better leakage reduction. This paper is a case study which utilizes earlier proposed pressure management techniques of the author itself. The author has shown the utilization of earlier proposed algorithm for leakage reduction as well as removal of pressure deficiency in actual water distribution system as a case study. The algorithm leads to overall leakage reduction of 10.43% (30.94 l/s). Considering different load condition, daily water saving of 2.673 ML, which is good enough for the survival of a population of 17,246 people more than the existing ones.

articleTitle: Vehicle Control Simulation System with Embedded Digital Real-Time Weather Station
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Vehicle Control Simulation System helps the driver in the driving process and is developed to automate, adapt, enhance vehicles for safety and better driving which helps to control things better. To avoid collisions and accidents safety features are designed which offer various automations that caution the driver. To address these particular needs, have included many adaptive features such as automated lighting, theft alarm, warning during over speeding, temperature and humidity information, connection to smartphones and way of controlling the car using an interactive voice response system, alert driver of other cars or dangers and indicate obstacles in blind spots while backing and also controlling all these features with ESP8266 Wi-Fi SoC wirelessly. In addition to the above functionalities, also an embedded a digital weather system into the model which provides us with the information of weather like temperature, barometric pressure, humidity, etc. in the neighboring as well as destination environment using offline web servers and updates information in the phone. So, by knowing the weather conditions ahead of the journey, can plan what precautions are to be taken and go well prepared.

articleTitle: Source Production for Free Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In the present scenario, the electricity bill has been increasing and the emission of pollution is getting high at the time of generating the electricity. To overcome this problem, a new method by using the magnets on the windmill has been adopted. When the wind is absent it can use the magnets as an alternative source to produce the electricity. To meet the demands the work proposed to produce the source of production for free energy generation. This concept utilizes the electricity generator with some neodymium magnets, small CPU fan and an USB booster (dc-dc converter) to produce electricity. The couple of magnets placed on this fan has relation with the neodymium magnets for a cause to generate the electricity. It generates the electrical signals which are later amplified in the dc-dc converter.

articleTitle: Bangladeshi Local Potatoes Dataset and Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Potato is one of the major foods in Bangladesh during winter which shows the most environmentally amiable vegetables. Variations of potatoes in Bangladesh that are grown here are extensively categorized into two divisions, high yielding and local. Assuredly, potato is the world's most important crop when it comes to rank according to the volume of the fresh products. Moreover, the minerals, fibers, and vitamins it delivers can serve convenience for human healthiness and guard against diseases. Recently, different kinds of potatoes of Bangladesh has been exporting to various countries worldwide. Hence, a lot of people are engaging in agriculture to cultivate potatoes. It is very essential for the farmers to acknowledge that; which kinds of potato cultivation will be beneficial according to the market price and cultivating process. This system can help agriculturists, farmers, and general people to find out the local species of potatoes. This dataset of locally recognized potatoes like Diamond Alu, Mete Alu, Lal Alu, Jam Alu, Lal Mishti Alu, Chhoto Lal Alu, Mete Chhora Alu, Shunno Alu, Shada Mishti Alu, and Keshar Alu. Using a dataset of potatoes (5190 images) that have been collected by us, this research trained a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and deep learning based model to identify potatoes. The model gets an accuracy of 98.87%.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic based QoS Management and Monitoring System for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Owing to the flexibility and cost-effectiveness of cloud computing, several large and medium types of business organizations are using cloud service for their business purpose. Guaranteeing Quality-of-Service (QoS) to the cloud's clients is a significant and unavoidable problem, especially for cloud media services like live streaming and cloud video conferencing. The main intention of this proposed paper is to develop a more reliable cloud client-side QoS monitoring and management system and thereby provide high-quality media services to the cloud customer. Fuzzy rules have developed this cloud client-side QoS monitoring and management system. Its experiment is done with real-time cloud architecture. The experimental analysis makes it clear that this method has many benefits for cloud service providers and cloud customers. Moreover, the results show the remarkable improvements of the client-side QoS attributes: throughput, latency and response time.

articleTitle: A Review of Bigdata and Machine Learning Techniques in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The study of big data by machine learning offers significant favorable circumstances for the assimilation and assessment of large amounts of complex medical services information. To adequately use machine learning devices in medical services, some constraints must be measured and key points must be measured, for example, its clinical use and ethics in the use of medical services. Favorable circumstances of machine learning incorporate adaptability and versatility contrasted and conventional biostatistical strategies, which makes it deployable for some errands, for example, hazard separation, finding and grouping, and endurance expectations. The health care services measure includes a lot of gigantic information that can be of various kinds and put in better places. The digitization of data, if appropriately dissected, prompts an expansion like cycles and administrations in the Healthcare area. In this specific situation, Machine Learning (ML) is the key empowering innovation to diminish the expenses of medical services extricating knowledge from information. The objective of ML is to improve a framework with no ceaseless human mediation. Medical Decision Support Systems (MDSS) are an additional incentive from one viewpoint by accelerating determination and care measures, then again decreasing the hour of clinical staff or concentrated learning.

articleTitle: Data Mining based Hybrid Latent Representation Induced Ensemble Model Towards Fraud Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The increasing growth of e-commerce and mobile payments has contributed to a rise in the effects of financial payment services fraud over the last few years. "At 2025, the losses in fraud around the world could amount to about $44 billion, according to McKinsey." Every year, trillions of dollars are lost from fraudulent card transactions. An efficient fraud detection system based on advanced machine learning techniques have gained excellent value in all Financial Institutions to reduce these losses. The proposed algorithm SLREnsemble (Stochastic Latent Representation Ensemble) is a hybrid model that uses deep neural network Autoencoders to obtain the latent representation of genuine and fraudulent transactions and these representations are given as an input to the balanced ensemble model. The technique is tested against other existing methods, i.e., Isolation Forest, Random Forest, and XGBoost algorithms, by various performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall. The results prove that the SLREnsemble model is highly efficient in Fraud detection and performs well with minimal training data and yields good precision, recall and f1-score with high computational speed values.

articleTitle: Teaching Staff Performance Analysis by Fuzzy Mamdani Inference System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this research, an Inference System of Fuzzy Mamdani system have been designed for the analysis of teaching skills of faculties in academic or educational institutes. Nowadays, various academic institutions have started web-based techniques to collect students' feedback of faculty teaching performance. The performance evaluation of faculty in teaching activities performance is a major key to build a fairer academic institute. Major purpose of faculty performance is to identify strength & weakness of professional development of a teacher. This soft computing technique by using Fuzzy Mamdani Inference System (FMIS) for evaluating faculty teaching performance will be useful for management of organization for evaluate faculty abilities with student outcomes.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Intelligent Vehicle Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the expansion in the quantity of vehicles on street, there has been a stamped increment in the quantity of violations including vehicle robbery. articleTitle: Deisgn of UWB Range of Micro strip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Antenna design and simulation is playing a vital role in 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification with MRI Brain Images Using 2-Level GLCM Features and Sparse Representation based Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Recently, detection of brain tumor using imaging techniques is a trending research area in the field of computer vision. Computer vision technology is popularly being used for tumor classification since the accuracy of diagnosis is very high. This research work proposes a novel scheme called Sparse Representation Segmentation with 2-Level GLCM and SVM classification (S2LGSVM) system for the segmentation and classification of brain. The MRI images are initially preprocessed using filtration and enhancement techniques. The enhanced MRI data are then segmented using a novel Sparse Representation Based Segmentation (SRBS) algorithm. The segmented data is used for feature extraction. A novel 2-Level Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (2L-GLCM) features are proposed for representing the segmented data. The 2L-GLCM features are obtained by first finding GLCM matrix for the MRI data. The same algorithm is then applied at the second level to extract the 2L-GLCM matrix. Finally, support vector machine (SVM) classifier classifies the extracted features. The images are classified into malignant and benign categories. Performance analysis is done using publicly available OASIS dataset. The acceptability of the proposed framework is evaluated and compared with other techniques used in the literature. The proposed SRBS segmentation achieved a maximum Jaccard Coefficient of 0.8167. The proposed S2LGSVMframework achieved an accuracy of 96.92%, specificity of 97.93% and precision of 95.82%.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis of Smart TV using Discrete Cosine Transforms
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The Smart TV, an IoT device is gaining a lot of popularity as an intelligent sensor device It has substituted the heirloom television system by bestowing competence in network and data connectivity as well as processing. This ultramodern technology has attracted viewers worldwide. With advancing technology, smart TV poses several challenges and security threats to consumer privacy. This vulnerability can have detrimental effects on the end user. To ensure video security in smart environment, a novel solution is proposed by using cryptanalysis with help of cosine transforms. Two dimensional discrete cosine transform (DCT) is used to compress and encode the video images which upon authentication by authorized user can be decompressed or decoded using inverse discrete transform (IDCT). Thereby, real-time security is provided to video applications in IoT like the Smart TV.

articleTitle: A Systematic Hybrid Smart Region based Detection (SRBD) Method for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Traditional object Detection methods are the most rudimentary and have many testing issues in computer vision, since they endeavor to find object models from hefty number of predefined classifications in naturalistic images. From object indicators and scene classifiers, the image presentation constructs complex groups which join various low-level picture highlights with significant level setting. This paper analyzes various details of general object detection methods like object proposal generation, detection frameworks, object extraction, context modeling methods and Region of classification. Also using a brief architecture of object detection with its algorithm techniques, and deep learning methods based on object detection frameworks were studied. This paper proposed A Systematic Hybrid Smart Region Based Detection Method (SRBD) for Object Detection and attempts to overcome the drawbacks of the existing systems like Faster R-CNN, SSD and Yolo.

articleTitle: Design of Amended Adaptive Equalizer using Butterfly Optimization Algorithm : Extension to LTE System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: An inadvertent demand for eminence communication systems has made a paradigm progress with the recent introduction of digital communication technologies. Adaptive Equalizers (AEs) in the digital communication systems have been successful in combating the contortions, which arise due to the increased data transmission. With the recent development in electronics domain, the need for improving AEs have become the central theme for many researches. The recent development in various areas of technology attempts to mimic the processes of nature and has proved to be extremely efficient in overcoming the hindrances faced pre viously. In this paper, an Amended Adapti ve Equalizer (AAE) has been proposed by using the Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (BOA). The convergence behavior as well as the Bit Error Rate (BER) performances of the projected AE have been investigated along with a comparison on different AEs, where Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithms and the Constant Modulus Algorithms (CMA) have been premeditated. Finally, the performance of the equalizer has been evaluated in Long Term Evolution (LTE) system.

articleTitle: An Efficient Design of Fault Tolerant Reversible Multiplexer Using QCA Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) is a modern nano-level based technology that is considered a replacement for the traditional CMOS technology due to its significant improvements in designing electronic circuits. In the construction of many electronic digital circuits, a multiplexer (MUX) is an essential block. This paper suggests, designs, and then compares an area-efficient fault-tolerant QCA reversible 2:1 MUX with the best existing architectures. The circuit has designed with a Fredkin gate and this is a parity preservation gate of 3: 3 size. Quantum Computing Architectural Design (QCAD) Designer tool evaluates the functional accuracy of the proposed structure. QCAD Pro is used to investigate the energy dissipation of the suggested MUX. Further, the consequence of temperature effect on maximum polarization and power consumption is analyzed. The results obtained are evidence that progress of 67% in QCA cell count, 66% in cell size, 68% in total area, and 68% in quantum cost as compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Propositional Aspect between Apache Spark and Hadoop Map-Reduce for Stock Market Data
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Big data analytics is becoming tremendously popular in every field today. Everyday lots of data are being generated and analyzed using big data analytics tools and technique. Here the technology used is apache spark and language used is Scala. So, in this paper study is being done on the behalf of research done in stock market data using apache spark technique. Here the nifty-50 data is taken to analyze the impact due to covid-19. As it is being seen that Covid-19 has affected almost everything around the globe, so the purpose is to analyze its effect on stock market. Thereafter comparison is done between the techniques used to analyze that massive volume of stock exchange data. Here the comparative analysis between Hadoop maps-reduce and apache spark on the behalf of some important parameter is being done. That concludes which technique is better for the analysis of the stock exchange data.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Quality of Public Physical Education Based on HMM and AHP
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Intelligent fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of the quality of public physical education based on HMM and AHP is discussed in this paper. This article first derives the transition probability of the state from the duration of the segment length, and demonstrates that the two are not independent of each other, and the probability of a state transitioning to another state can be completely determined by the state's self-transition probability, and it is explained theoretically the necessity of introducing the absorption state. Data quality assessment considers the user's requirements for the general comprehensive data application, and conducts a comprehensive inspection and evaluation of the production, hence, consider the fuzzy clustering and the AHP to construct efficient data analytic framework. The simulations have highlighted the performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Hybrid Color Feature Image Categorization using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Agricultural products, particularly fruits, forms an important part of trading. The agriculture industry has gained attention in recent years for the purpose of categorizing the fruit crop based on their visual quality. Sorting and grading plays an important role among post harvesting operations. Traditional sorting was human-dependent, which is time consuming, less efficient due to labor shortage during peak seasons therefore automation of the fruits grading system is needed which in turn depend on external features. Several machine learning techniques for two class problem are applied for fruit image classification. In this paper Machine Learning is applied to multiclass fruit categorization using color feature. The improved model based on hybrid color feature is developed and presented to benefit agriculture industry to make the process of sorting easy for local vendors with color features. The training of model is performed using support vector machine (SVM) classifier on fruit dataset which includes 6 fruit categories. The result shows that the use of hybrid color feature with linear kernel technique with OneVsOne coding design enhanced the accuracy by 2%.

articleTitle: Virtual DataStack for Application Domains: Concepts, Challenges and Generation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Dataset plays a major role in evaluating Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Intelligence (BI) and enterprise software. To prove the efficacy of any algorithm / software and also its limitation with respect to the size of the input data, it has to be exercised on a large dataset. Creating such a large dataset is a challenging task especially with near real time data. In this paper, a layered architecture to construct Virtual DataStack (VDS) is proposed. The VDS contains near real time synthetic virtual datasets (specific to a particular domain) along with other components that comprises the generation of datasets. Virtual DataStack for CampusStack (academic campus management) domain has been generated and results prove that Query Inclusive Computational Logic reduces lines of code as well as the time taken significantly. This paper focuses mainly on efficient generation of near real time data for enterprise domains with a specific attention to Education Domain and CampusStack.

articleTitle: The Ideal Block Ciphers - Correlation of AES and PRESENT in Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this digital era, the usage of technology has increased rapidly and led to the deployment of more innovative technologies for storing and transferring the generated data. The most important aspect of the emerging communication technologies is to ensure the safety and security of the generated huge amount of data. Hence, cryptography is considered as a pathway that can securely transfer and save the data. Cryptography comprises of ciphers that act like an algorithm, where the data is encrypted at the source and decrypted at the destination. This paper comprises of two ciphers namely PRESENT and AES ciphers. In the real-time applications, AES is no more relevant especially for segmenting the organizations that leverage RFID, Sensors and IoT devices. In order to overcome the strategic issues faced by these organization, PRESENT ciphers work appropriately with its super lightweight block figure, which has the equivalent significance to both security and equipment arrangements. This paper compares the AES (Advance encryption standard) symmetric block cipher with PRESENT symmetric block cipher to leverage in the industries mentioned earlier, where the huge consumption of resources becomes a significant factor. For the comparison of different ciphers, the results of area, timing analysis and the waveforms are taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Bio Sensing Chip for Smart Clothes
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The urgent need for today's world is to get everything in the shortest possible time. People want to see their health status and are looking for urgent care. But, the elderly and the disabled cannot avail such facilities without human help. They have a lot of trouble reminding anyone about their own health conditions. In order to overcome this difficulty, an efficient automotive along with vehicle set-up is developed in this paper. The proposed system contains body condition tracking strategies for feverishness, pulse oximetry and heart rate. This body condition tracking set-up displays the body heat, pulse oximetry and heart beat count data in the LCD and transmits an automated alert to family people or medics. To identify fall down of elderly, another system is added. Depending upon the force of fall, static or dynamic states of the person and the attached sensor unit, the data exceeds the normal value and the falling machine receives the signal in which system sends an automatic notification. This paper will focus on the basics system of health care monitoring and care for the elderly and disabled people.

articleTitle: Generalized method to validate social distancing using median angle proximity methodology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Social distancing in industries as well as all public places due to the breakdown of pandemic of COVID-19 is currently of global interest. An advanced global solution for social distancing monitoring among the group of people in real time using computer vision and deep learning is proposed. A state of art method, Median angle proximity method is proposed on the coordinates obtained from the YOLOv3 (You only look once) algorithm to determine the predefined threshold resulting in the social distancing violating bounding boxes. The violating bounding boxes are then saved as single images using deep sort method. All the parts of the work are done using opensource programming language. The work has met all the requirements planned and is considered to be ready for deployment in real time with an average accuracy of 85%

articleTitle: Methods and Techniques for Privacy Preserving in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The rapid developments in blockchain technology in various field mostly concerns about decentralization, transparency and security. The publishing nodes and subscribers nodes in the networks ensures the transaction is recorded in the ledger by giving some transaction fees to the miners. The security is achieved by the various consensus algorithms used in the network. The blockchain technique is widely used in various applications like healthcare, education, supply chain, auction system, E-voting, etc. All these application contains valuable information that can be inferred by attackers through various learning analytic methods while sharing in the public ledgers. So privacy is at risk for all these types of data that are outsourced. The paper presents a study on the various types of techniques that are carried out in the field of privacy preserving for blockchain technology.

articleTitle: AI based Sustainable Approach for Metal Extraction from E-Waste: A Comprehensive literature review
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Due to the overwhelming increase in the electrical and electronic products every year the rate of discarding older or damaged electrical or electronics products has also increased. Proper disposal or recycling of the discarded products of Electrical and Electronic waste is of major concern for research as it contains some harmful substances. There are several literatures being reported for extraction of electronic waste using different methods. Electro chemical, Pyrometallurgical, Hydrometallurgical and Bioleaching are the most enhancing methods to extract metals. Among all these methods, electrochemical is one of the most efficient method reported. (80-95) % of the metal extraction is reported in former mentioned method by using different electrolytes. Additionally, different combinations of electrodes are used to separately extract the metals from E-Waste after the pretreatment and chemical leaching of the Waste. To identify the best efficient electro chemical methods and its challenges for extraction of metals from e-waste, a literature review of research papers has been carried out during the period between 2010 to 2019. This work will conclude the comparative analysis of all these methods for extraction of metals from e-waste based on some factors like: Energy efficiency, Environment friendliness, Economical and Efficient extraction of metals.

articleTitle: Automatic Fracture Detection in Hand Bone Using MATLAB and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Rapidly discovering the possible technological advantages are evolving every day in distinct fields, especially in the clinical circumstances. articleTitle: Selection of quantum computing architecture using a decision tree approach
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Richard Feynman proposed the idea of quantum computing for the first time in 1982 (R. P. Feynman, 1982) [1]. In the last few years, various industries have started accepting quantum solutions to their business problems. Universal quantum computers are being built by Industry tech giants to solve problems in business, engineering, and science. A variety of quantum software projects are being developed using different quantum devices, algorithms, frameworks, and quantum programming languages. To correctly identify the problems that show promise for quantum advantage, to develop proof-of-concept implementations of quantum solutions, and to actually develop software implementing these solutions is a challenging feat. This paper helps ease the decision-making process in choosing the right software architecture based on the type of the quantum project.

articleTitle: Application of Attention Model Hybrid Guiding based on Artificial Intelligence in the Course of Intelligent Architecture History
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Application of the attention model hybrid building based on the artificial intelligence in the course of the intelligent architecture history is studied in this article. A Hadoop distributed architecture using big data processing technology which combines basic building information with the building energy consumption data for the data mining research methods, and conduct a preliminary design of a Hadoop-based public building energy consumption data mining system. The principles of the proposed model were summarized. At first, the intelligent firewall processes the decision data faster, when the harmful information invades. The intelligent firewall can monitor and also intercept the harmful information in a timelier manner. Secondly, develop a problem data processing plan, delete and identify different types of problem data, and supplement the deleted problem data according to the rules obtained by data mining. The experimental results have reflected the efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Current-fed DAB Converter for DC Microgrid with Active Power Control
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of the Current-fed dual active bridge (CFDAB) DC-DC converter with a Proportional Integral based Fuzzy Controller (PIFC) and to realize the bidirectional power-sharing strategy of the converter in the given test system. The test system consists of a DC microgrid, an AC utility, Interlinking Converter (IC), and a CFDAB converter. The CFDAB and IC provides the bidirectional power flow between the AC and DC system. The PI controller of the CFDAB converter has limited operating points and complicated controller design. Hence, it lacks robustness and fails to achieve the control actions. To overcome the above issues, this study introduces the PIFC controller for improving the performance of the CFDAB converter because of its heuristic behavior. The DC microgrid test system with CFDAB converter is demonstrated using MATLAB/Simulink with various case studies. The effectiveness of the PIFC is validated with various dynamic conditions of the system.

articleTitle: A Survey on Personality Trait Recognition from Handwriting: Approach and Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: An individual's personality is the true mirror of an individual's thoughts and qualifications as well as skill, physical strength, character, etc. Judging someone is the prime characteristic that happens when met someone or communicate with someone, it's human nature. The identification of such a personality relates to a person's handwriting. Writing is a good way of communication and the study of this field is included in graphology. This study shows that a person's mind concentrates more when he or she is writing. Handwriting is an expression of the subconscious mind or through of individual's mind. There is a relation between handwriting and personality which is presented in this study. It also discusses the extracted features, challenges, application of handwriting analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Guiding Quality Evaluation Model Based on Regional Ecological Safety Performance Evaluation and Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Analysis of guiding quality evaluation model based on regional ecological safety performance evaluation and general information mining is well studied in this article. Knowledge utilization is a key link in the knowledge management. It refers to process of realizing transformation from knowledge theory to practice and the extension of the practice level by means of exchange and sharing on the basis of creation and accumulation. Inspired by this, the article has too many aspects of novelties. At first, reduces the clustering to a constrained nonlinear programming problem, and solves the problem through various optimization methods to obtain the fuzzy partition. Secondly, the structure rule of a new classification is designed for an approximate space of different perspective makes use of information entropy. Finally, the proposed model is applied for the performance evaluation. The experimental results have shown the performance.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Efficient Phenotyping for Agronomics
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The evaluation of soil and plants has been a costly, labor-intensive, and time-consuming process traditionally. With the advancements in technology, the phenotypic variations in plants and their corresponding information can be extracted efficiently using IoT, WSN, and computer vision and processed with machine learning, artificial intelligence, and such cutting-edge techniques. This can help in accelerating the developments in vegetation, improving the genomic selection, and enable high-throughput plant phenotyping. In this work, the phenotypic characteristics of the crop and the soil conditions are assessed using deep learning convolutional neural networks based on the data obtained by the IoT sensors and multispectral imaging from small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across the agricultural area. The plant quality and leaf diseases are identified. 99.9% precision and recall are obtained with an overall accuracy of 95%. This technique is quick, cost-effective, and reliable.

articleTitle: An Automatic System for Detection & Suppression of Epileptic Seizure
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Epilepsy is a disorder of nerves and the nervous system, where the normal signals of neuron electrical activity becomes upset, causing abnormal problems to the patients. The aim is to design a portable real-time monitoring and controlling device for epileptic seizure detection and suppression. This wireless network embedded system indudes, a stimulator, and a microcontroller with MAX 232. The microcontroller acquires the heart rate signals and muscular movement signals and then executes feature extraction on those signals to decide if a seizure has occurred In case a seizure is confirmed after the real-time processing, an enabling signal excites the stimulator to generate stimulating pulses to suppress the seizure, at the same time the message regarding the condition of the patient is sent to the physician using GSM.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Cloud Integrated Sensor Network using inter Sensor Owners based multi-hop Routing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: An energy-efficient model for the sensor cloud is proposed by using inter-sensor owners based on multi-hop routing. End users want to acquire the sensor data, which passes through the cloud to reach the required sensor that contains the data. Traditionally routing of traffic takes place within the sensor nodes present within an owner. As in the traditional approach, the distance between the sensors is more as routing occurs within one sensor owner. As a result, energy consumption is more. Our approach is useful when more than one sensor owners deploy their sensors in the same area. In our proposed method, the inter sensor owner routing saves energy as the distance between the sensors decreases. Our approach's simulation shows that the inter sensor owners routing save energy compared to the intra-sensor owner routing.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Water Environment Data Monitoring and Visual Analysis based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Intelligent water environment data monitoring and visual analysis based on IoT is studied in this paper. When carrying out the environmental pollution control and protection work, it is necessary to scientifically use the advanced big data technology. Novelties are reflected from listed aspects. (1) When carrying out environmental pollution control and protection work, it is necessary to scientifically use the advanced big data technology and then the system will be implemented effectively. (2) Through the training of a large amount of data, the neural network model can also mine the complex nonlinear relationship behind the data, so that the data can be processed well. The sets of the experiment have shown the satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Design of Orthogonal Matching Pursuit Architecture based on Compressed Sampling Using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In our work, a Field-programmable gate array (FPGA) based architecture for compressive sensing using Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm is suggested. The storing and transmission of data is done and it will be made efficient when the sampled signal is compressed. In this technique of compressive sensing, the demerits of directly achieving compressed signal without coming across any transitional stage by considering all samples is reduced. Reconstruction of sampled data will be done using numerical computing intensive theorems which has many flaws. Implementation of Reconstruction stage is complex software implementation of these algorithms is awfully slow and consumption of the power will be more as the system has large number of layers due to most of the resource sharing at multiple levels. Contrarily implementation in hardware has much advantage in hardware parallelism, ability of creating custom data path and hardware dedication for each task. In proposed method hardware implementation OMP algorithm is utilized because of its shorter computation time and low complex nature. The main objective of the proposed method is to implement an OMP algorithm to optimize essential reconstruction time without negotiating intended accuracy.

articleTitle: Data Mining based Action Research on Speculation Online Guiding Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Action research on the speculation English online guiding mode in art colleges from data collection to the data understanding is conducted in this paper. Through the collection, analysis and identification of the large amount of the emotional related data generated by online learners, they can understand their emotional state. After the data collection, two stage data understanding model is proposed in this research work. Stage one: network learning data collection stage, data processing and learning state analysis stage stages. Stage two: GAN model is still based on the idea of generating a network and a discriminant network game, but the input of the generating network is not only a noise signal, proposed work fit this model to match with the online scenario. The experiment has proven that the proposed framework is efficient.

articleTitle: An Efficient Bidirectional broadcasting using Signal Initiation and Data Aggregation for WSN
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor networks are the need of the day due to the ease of installation and use. Moreover, with the current advancements of technology, it's quite difficult to rely on wired networks due to overhead like the cable expenses, connection and repairing cost, limitation in movement and so on. In this Research work implements a broadcast network where Band based bi-directional algorithm is used. Using this algorithm, sensor data can be broadcasted towards the mobile sink with less expense and reduces data redundancy. Simulations are used to illustrate the efficiency of the transferability of data and energy spent by the system.

articleTitle: Triggering and Auditing the Event During Intrusion Detections in WSN’s Defence Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: WSNs are extensively used in defence application for monitoring militant activities in various ways in large unknown territories. Here WSNs has to have large set of distributed systems in the form as sensors nodes. Along with security concerns, False Alarming is also a factor which may interrupt the service and downgrade the application further. Thus in our work we have made sure that when a trigger is raised to an event, images can be captured from the connected cameras so that it will be helpful for both auditing the event as well as capturing the scene which led to the triggering of the event.

articleTitle: Diverse Operations in Uncertain and Probabilistic Database - Trio
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A probabilistic and uncertain database is a real database containing uncertain data which is probabilistic. The available probabilistic and uncertain database management prototypes and systems such as Trio have limited query functionalities. Trio does not support important query functionalities such as intersect all query and working of multiple aggregate functions in the select clause. This article demonstrates the modifications in query handling process in Trio database system. The modifications allow the user to use intersect all clause and implement multiple aggregate functions in the select clause. The modified system also allow the user to represent graphically the extracted data using histogram which in turn used to compare the different range of values present in the relation. Moreover, with these modifications the user can now fire diverse queries over Trio as per his/her requirements. Thus the additional query functionalities implemented in this work has made the Trio database more user friendly.

articleTitle: A Detailed Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Support to Measure Negative Impacts Created by the Abnormal Growth of Prosopis Juliflora: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Rangeland ecosystems are continuously declining these days due the uncontrolled spread of mesquite. Prosopis juliflora is one of the most invasive trees spreading in the entire world these days. It was initially introduced in different parts of world to address erosion problems but with the passage of time it has become a crucial invader. Since there is limitation of the data available on the spread of this plant, there is a great need of using machine intelligence to measure and control the negative impacts. This paper has shown a review of studies related to the problems created by P.Juliflora in different parts of world and the high need of Artificial Intelligence as its control measure. Presently, there is very less information is available on the area already occupied by the weed and its removal is performed by manual instruments which are very expensive and time consuming. AI can be used to assess Prosopis cover using satellite imagery and machine learning. The algorithm, powered by AI, can reduce the field work and time to analyse the impacts and growth.

articleTitle: Real-time Monitoring and Comprehensive Analysis Framework for Rainwater and Soil Pollution based on Big Data Feature Extraction and IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Real-time monitoring and comprehensive analysis framework for rainwater and soil pollution based on big data feature extraction and Internet of Things (IoT) is discussed in this article. The procedural operation technology of the dispatch automation system is proposed, and introduces the overall structure and implementation plan of the dispatch automation system. The novelty is summarized into the following core aspects. (1) By representing the reconstructed training samples with low rank, a robust discriminant feature space constraint term was designed to enable the learning of feature subspace to improve the data analytic effectiveness. (2) For the forward propagation and backward propagation, the direction of the traversal and the operations that must be performed are different. Based on this, the novel real-time analysis model is designed. The proposed model is simulated on the hardware devices. The results have shown that the proposed method is efficient.

articleTitle: Efficient Redundancy Processing Framework of Association Rules Model based on Hypergraph in Information Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Efficient redundancy processing framework of the association rules model based on hypergraph in the information pattern recognition is designed in this paper. For big data analysis or pattern recognition problems, data sets have the characteristics of the diverse formats and sparse information, it is essential to extract the vital information to obtain the efficient analysis of the data sets. The interval value attribute data set is a data set containing multiple attribute data. These data are clustered together, and the types are huge, and it is difficult to reach agreement when classifying. Hence, his feature is used in the research work to construct the novel analytic framework. The experiment results have proven that the proposed algorithm can effectively process the data with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Multimedia System and Information Modelling System for Computer Aided Red Dance Creation with Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Multimedia system and the information modelling system for the computer aided red dance creation with virtual reality are implemented in this manuscript. The development and design of the whole system should be based on the high requirements of the stability, reliability and advancement, and the development of the system should adopt dynamic open architecture, the novel multimedia system is implemented. This language expresses the use of data elements, constraints, relationships, rules and the functions to define and classify the resource components. To establish a hierarchy as the resource components, it can be used for the interpretation function. A novel tool is designed to finalize the system. This investigation is compared with the other state-of-the-art approaches has shown the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Case-By-Case Meta-Analysis from A Bayesian Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Due to the advancement of science and the tendency to use the smallest of humans in needless clinical trials in many situations, the role of meta-analysis to summarize published study with the same objective, using statistics is becoming more and more fundamental. The integration of the knowledge available makes it easier to understand and allows strong conclusions. For example, increasing the number of clinical trials encourages a rising need to conduct meta-analyses, making complexity possible. The purpose of the research was therefore to suggest a Bayesian meta-analytical methodology. Bayesian method was proposed to carry out a case-by-case meta-analysis. The procedure was based on the mixture of the posterior distributions of the parameter in question from each study that is a percentage of the meta-analysis, thus producing a combined posterior distribution as a meta-analytical measure. In addition, a brief comparison is made between the proposed method and some methods used in meta-analysis. Some examples with simulated and real data are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Network Crime Information Retrieval Framework based on Facial Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Network crime information retrieval framework based on facial image recognition is designed in this article. Due to the intelligence and professionalism of crime methods, the variety of criminal methods, and the high degree of concealment of crimes, the detection of cybercrime is much more difficult than traditional cases, which brings great difficulty to the investigation of the case which leads to the detection with low rate. The face analytic model is used to construct the efficient crime data modelling system. The regular term of the ideal coding coefficient matrix is introduced to represent the coefficients of samples for the same types which are as close as possible. The representation coefficients of samples of different types are as different as possible, which also increases the discrimination of coding coefficients. The comprehensive analysis of the model is tested and compared with the state-of-the-art methodologies. The experiment shows the detection accuracy has been improved to 98.77%.

articleTitle: Multiband Microstrip Antenna Design for Space Research Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Now a days communication needs antennas with multiple band characteristics to support in special wireless applications. articleTitle: Application of Statistical Analysis and Association Data Mining in College Students' Mental Health Intelligent Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Application of statistical analysis and association data mining in the college students' mental health intelligent evaluation system is studied in this article. This paper uses the technology based methods to achieve the comprehensive analysis. In quantum mechanics, the microscopic particle has wave-particle duality, its motion is not the orbital motion, in the principle it is impossible to track the motion of the particle.
