Some transactions that happen accidentally in the original database are likely to happen frequently in the next time period. This feature is created to analyze the framework efficiently and implemented through the software.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Identification of Primary Speaker in Voice-Controlled Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: At present, so many low budget recording devices available, recording lectures, meetings, conferences and events have become a very easy option for everyone but also at the same time these devices lead to unclear speeches. An advanced methodology of identifying the primary speaker is introduced to record noisy audio file given in any regional language. The speaker turns and speaker lengths are examples of features which provide greater insight in the detection of primary speakers. This also provides the transcript of the primary speaker audio chunk to the end-user. Speaker diarization is the process of identifying various chunks in given audio belonging to different homogenous speakers where the count of speakers is unknown. This process is a mixture of segmentation and clustering. Speech segmentation detects the speaker change points followed by grouping them based on the speaker. Thus, Speaker Diarization is the most important step in the Identification of the primary speaker.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on EEG Signals for Seizure Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Convulsions is a medical condition that affect the nervous system of human body. In medical language it is called as seizures. It is not a disease but it is a disorder, it usually occurs in the human brain of all the age groups irrespective of their age, starting from child age group to adults. It is usually caused by sudden change in the brain or a sudden electrical activity that occurs in the brain. Based on the duration, Convulsions are classified into different types, they are local convulsions, focal convulsion, generalized tonic clonic convulsions and partial convulsions. Convulsions will usually occur in the trauma patients [Road traffic accidents] and Post-operative i.e., brain surgery patients, alcoholic [drunker], stress life style conditions and Hypocalcaemia patients [Low calcium levels]. This detection is possible by analyzing the electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. Confluent advantages of all product functions (PFs) are once again transmitted in the high-performance genetic algorithm (GA)-technique to the same division model. Average classification accuracy of the GA-SVM technique is approximately more than 89.01% in all attempts.

articleTitle: Design of efficient BCD adder with five input majority generators for quantum cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The CMOS technology has been pushed by the constant scaling down of the feature size to approach its theoretical and functional limitations. In order to achieve low power, area and delay parameters new distinct technologies are evolving to replace the CMOS technology. Quantum dot cellular automata (QCA) is one technology which is used to model different arithmetic circuits. In QCA technology, the design of the adder is a fundamental requirement for a high performance arithmetic device. The heart of the arithmetic device in the processor is the BCD adder. In this paper BCD adder for QCA is implemented with five input majority gates. The new approach has tested and the delay of the recently proposed existing systems and the new system has been analyzed by using Xilinx software. The delay of new design is minimized when contrast with the three input and combination of three and five input existing systems.

articleTitle: Automating Guide selection process of the Department through Web Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This is a website where guide selection was implemented. In this process every student has the access to view the profile of all teachers to register them as their project guides. First come First serve procedure is followed in this site. Selection of guides is based on the specialization of the Faculties of the Department. The main agenda is to assign faculties strong at particular areas to students’ projects based on that area. Faculty name has to be registered with all relevant details. The student register his/her details in the portal. The faculty register his/her details in the portal. The student checks for availability of the guide. If the guide is available then the student selects the guide and the guide slot availability is decremented by one. If the guide is not available the student has to select another guide from the portal. The list of selected students can be viewed by faculty. The guide selection detail will be displayed on the student portal. The complete details can be downloaded as a CSV file from the admin login. Technologies used for implementation are: HTML with bootstrap, Node Js/PhP , MySql database, Cloud Server: It is published through amazon web services.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Three Transistor SRAM Cell using 45nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Random Access Memory plays a crucial role in data processing in various computing systems for faster applications. A processor always fetches the data from the main memory for processing, sometimes the same data may be required for the processing and need to be fetched repeatedly from the main memory results time consuming. Cache memory supports faster data storage and access by storing instances of programs and data which is routinely accessed by the processor. Therefore, the cache memory is used to store recently fetched data and when a processor requests to fetch the data the controller will first check the data in cache, if the fetched data is there in the cache then it will be fetched otherwise the controller will fetch the data from the main memory. Therefore, the cache memory is useful for improving speed of processing without wasting much time for fetching the repeated data. This paper deals with various structures of single ended S-RAM cells and proposes a novel three transistor S -RAM cell design Using Tanner 45nm Technology.

articleTitle: An N-step Look Ahead Algorithm Using Mixed (On and Off) Policy Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm for reinforcement learning is proposed. Q-learning and SARSA are one of the most famous algorithms used in Reinforcement learning. Q-learning gives the most optimal path whereas SARSA gives the safest path. This paper proposes an algorithm that allows users to flexibly chose between safer or faster path in any given environment by altering the hyper parameter n. The approach taken to achieve this is N-step look ahead. In this the agent will update the initial states value after it has taken n steps using on- policy reinforcement learning and in adjacent step it applies off- policy RL. Using this technique, the algorithm overcomes the overestimation of value function prevalent in Q-learning as it emphasizes more on on-policy updates. This algorithm allows the user alter the dependency on bootstrapping and sampling in updating the value function.

articleTitle: Review of computational approaches to Parkinson’s disease gene prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a chronic neuro-degenerative disease that affects the central nervous system. Since the causes of the disease are still unknown, both genetic and environmental factors are believed to be involved. Therefore, the identification and prediction of this genetic disorder plays an important role in early detection and treatment. The genomic data is extremely large and distorted, so the use of R tools can make the analysis and pre- processing of data easier. There are several computational approaches to the prediction of this disorder which varies with its accuracy and performance.

articleTitle: Fusion of Structural and Textural Features for Glaucoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Glaucoma is a major cause of crippling of vision and affects millions around the globe. Computational methods to decipher the patterns in the eye to detect the presence of the disease are widely being researched across the world. Considering the gravity of the problem, the cost of false negatives is tremendously high as it is tantamount to denying the patient the timely clinical intervention needed. This paper proposes to cut the rate of false negatives by collating the predictions of multiple classifiers.A confident conclusion is arrived at only in the event of convergence of predictions of all the classifiers used. Otherwise it is left to the wisdom of the clinician to further test and ascertains the diagnosis.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Architectural Modeling and Decoration Design System based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Three-dimensional architectural modeling and the decoration design system based on virtual reality is presented in this article. With the continuous development of intelligent building, the design of home intelligent integrated wiring system will become the trend of social development in the future, and gradually accepted by people. It is believed that in the next few years, a home intelligent system with stable operation, integrated system, functional use, humanized operation and individualized application will play an extraordinary role in people's life. The key of virtual reality technology is virtual scene modeling, that is, the construction of virtual world, because the quality of virtual world modeling is the key to produce immersion. This paper defines the novel pattern for the decoration design system with the data analysis and computer system. The experiment results have shown that the proposed model has satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Computer Data Processing Mode in the era of Big Data: from Pattern Recognition to Intelligent Sensing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Computer data processing mode in the era of big data from pattern recognition to intelligent sensing is discussed in this paper. Intelligence refers to the interconnection between things and things and people through the Internet of Things and mobile Internet, combined with the general big data computing, communication, artificial intelligence and other technologies. Neighborhood dependence reflects the proportion of approximate samples to all samples under decision class in mixed information system, and it is also a measure to describe the degree of relationship between conditional attribute set and decision attribute, so it can be used as a heuristic function to reduce the attribute of mixed information system. This paper designed the model from the collection to processing, from pattern analysis to the intelligent sensing. The experimental results have proven that the proposed model can sense the data effectively.

articleTitle: Dehaze Model to Improve Object Visibility Under Atmospheric Degradation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Optically captured images from the outdoor scenes will be humiliated by natural occurrences of Fog, Mist and Haze. This is due to atmospheric absorption and scattering of visible information, resulting in poor object visibility. It is necessary to estimate the quantifiable parameters of this atmospheric degradation to improve the visibility. Dehazing models attempt to estimate scattering parameters. Single image dehazing models are observed to possess estimation of inaccurate textures, thereby leading to blocking artifacts. The imbalances in the concentration of atmospheric particles and air-light are crucial, that should be mitigated. The available models have to be improved in terms of image parameters such as contrast, saturation and color information. The work reported in this paper emphasized the model that estimates intensified transmission map from the hazy images with color distortions and thereby exploiting scattering parameters for dehazing.

articleTitle: A Design of Hybrid Powertrain with Parallel Configuration for Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Due to rising fuel prices, shortage of fuels and increasing air pollution there is more demand for electric vehicles. But in India the main concern is the lack of charging stations to recharge the electric vehicles during any emergency situation. So, e-bikes cannot be used for longer range. The hybrid powertrain is used to solve this problem. The primary drive of the powertrain is electric motor and secondary drive uses an IC engine. The power train consists of free wheels and fixed sprocket which allows to operate motorcycle on electric motor as well as IC engine. The use of hybrid powertrain improves overall range of motorcycles.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network based Automated Workload Forecasting in a Contact Center
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In a contact center, Customer Service Agents (CSAs) provide product support or valuable information to customers. A key requirement in a contact center is to balance customer satisfaction, by having enough CSAs to support incoming calls, and not too many to reduce costs. This project aims to simplify and improve forecasting and scheduling of CSAs by contact center administrators or operations managers. An approach that helps to forecast demand for required services are described and it assigns relevant services to CSAs without the administrative overhead. Workload forecasting helps to predict the service demand that can help to manage incoming call peaks, utilize CSAs precisely, and minimize the idle time of CSAs in a contact center. Our approach is to look at the previous historical contact center data for an extended period, learn the patterns and trends, and then forecast the overall incoming call count for each service supported by the contact center. It has been found that, neural network techniques namely, traditional Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and its variants Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and Bi-Directional LSTM (BiLSTM) were capable of forecasting incoming calls volumes and the effects of this forecasting supported accurate CSA scheduling.

articleTitle: Multilinguistic approach towards Information Retrieval System for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper delivers the manipulation of the lingual perspective and its approaches in the Information Retrieval System. Research work explored the linguistic aspects of Information Retrieval, namely Bilingual, Cross-lingual, and Multilingual IR With the advancement and rise of globalization, the importance of the concept of information in form of Big Data has become a priority. The modern age and socialism give rise to large amounts of data due to which the requirement of information in different languages becomes a primary requirement and thus Multilingual Information Retrieval System approach for Big Data came into existence. Though in use, this field of Computer Science is still under research and optimization.

articleTitle: Drug Administration Route Classification using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In the Pharmaceutical industries, the drug discovery process involves huge investment and is timeconsuming. The pre-clinical procedure may even take several years. There are several drug repositories that hold information about millions of drugs. Researchers around the globe continuously synthesize new compounds and explore its pharmaceutical activities. While its inhibition characteristics against diseases are diagnosed in the first phase, the second phase of testing would be the drug administration route. The route of administration like Oral, Parenteral, and Topical is identified at this stage. In the traditional manual investigation, only through biological lab testing, the administration route is determined. This paper investigates the performance of machine learning models in the classification of the drug administration route. Machine learning models like Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Decision Tree were applied to the dataset and the effect of feature reduction on prediction accuracy was studied. Random Forest which is an ensemble learning model achieved high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Framework for detection of cardiac disease by interpreting ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cardiac disease is the prominent cause of demise all over the world, researchers are exploring to identify the disease at early stage by self-diagnosing or by interpreting medical images. Heart disease can be identified by examining the reports of Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and Cardiac computed tomography (CT). In this research paper a framework is developed for identification of heart problem by interpreting electrocardiogram (ECG) signal using Pan Tompkins algorithm and further classification of disease on the basis of beats per minute. Classification of heart disease is done in 3 categories: Normal, Bradycardia, and Tachycardia.

articleTitle: An Optimal Heuristic Model for Greedy and Efficient Consolidation Process in Cloud Datacenters
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Today, cloud computing has become an integrated solution for the entrepreneurs to deploy their business applications and to obtain the immense advantages of the cloud. Virtualization increased the cloud productivity and decreased the energy consumption by mapping the physical systems into logical virtual machines. Uneven distribution of load among the hosts may generate the host over subscription and under subscription issues, which impacts negatively on QoS management and energy consumption of cloud. Server consolidation is the convenient solution for handling the host underutilization issues. Although the former researches were proposed several advancements in consolidation, it is still suffering in selection of optimal threshold values and controls the aggressive migrations. This research work has proposed an optimal heuristic model for greedy and efficient consolidation process in cloud datacenters. Experimental results proven that the proposed consolidation model defined an optimal threshold value to save the energy and the greedy consolidation policy controlled the aggressive migrations better than the former consolidation models.

articleTitle: Research and Development of APP and HCI based on Audio Data Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Research and development of the string music auxiliary training APP based on audio data feature extraction is presented in this article. Mobile platform-based APP testing mainly considers the APP installation and uninstallation testing, functional testing, UI testing, core compatibility testing, cross-event testing, security testing. This article combines the novel framework design pattern to construct the novel methodologies. A core hierarchical two-step segmentation algorithm is used to segment the audio stream into audio units with large differences between the segments and small differences within segments. The experiment has proven the performance of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Database Training: Requirement to Exploitation in Hyperspectral Imagery
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In Artificial Intelligence (AI) batch size and epoch value for training a neural network has shown its importance about iteration size. Its importance in hyperspectral imagery to represent a complete dataset is not only restricted to the image size but also to the number of channels that the image comprises of. To strike a balance for epoch in comparison of number of channels under test is the highlight of this paper. Dimensionality processing of a vector input into patchable scalar terms via pre-processing skill providing solution to the overfitting problems of the databases as the prerequisite. The deterministic starting point of the seed during random sequence generation not only promises the reproducibility but has helped us provide a great breakthrough for database preparations for faster classification in hyperspectral imagery applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analytic Scheme for Classification of Novel Models
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Classification is one of the major tasks in supervised learning. This had a great impact on deep leaning in developing various State-of-the-art architectures every year. These models can capture invariances by extracting the finest features by variant design models developed using Convolution Neural Networks. These deep networks have proven their resilience in the large scale image recognition by overhauling the existing drawbacks in architectures.In this research, a complete analytical scheme is developed to extract features from various models and to depict its performance on Fruits-360 dataset. During the analysis, the data is processed from feature extraction block to classification block. After the classification, the individual models' performance is evaluated and assessed with standard classification metrics. Out of these, an optimal model is selected in all prospects. It is observed that VGG models tend to outperform the existing models by capturing invariances by providing transferability on variant tasks. The networks VGG-16, VGG-19 obtained the highest precision of 97.2±0.005, 96.6±0.66 respectively. A pair-plot is obtained to analyse the behaviour pattern of predicted labels to that of true labels. This research is a first attempt to analyse the behaviour of pre-trained models on Fruits-360 dataset.

articleTitle: A Parallel Implementation of Q-learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Q-learning has been one of the most used algorithms in reinforcement learning. There have been a lot of improvements in the speed of convergence of algorithm and many other improvements for various types of environments. Parallelizing the algorithm is one of the very useful improvements for Q-learning. Parallelizing the algorithm can mean the algorithm can run at multiple times the speed on capable systems. In this paper a technique to parallelize the algorithm is proposed. Experimental results are presented with the improvements achieved and a theoretical reasoning of the algorithm's merit in comparison with other works done in the field are also written.

articleTitle: Towards a collaborative approach for recommendation of services using a domain of ontology and agents
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Collaboration between companies provides a means of communication between individuals from different entities having a common goal. Collaborative work involves the sharing of expertise and resources. However, this sharing of resources must be done reliably and rapidly for effective decision making. In this article, an agent-based architecture for a collaborative decision support system that involves recommendation and negotiation is proposed in order to facilitate the allocation of a service by an enterprise considering fixed multi-criteria. This contribution offers a collective behavioral environment with a personalized search and time savings.

articleTitle: A Novel Compact Differential-Fed Dual-Polarized Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this communication, a novel compact two dualpolarized (DP) differential-fed high input-isolation dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is explored. The DRA is consisted of a rectangular dielectric resonator (DR) excited by a rectangular slot on the ground plane. articleTitle: Ensemble Classification Approach for Opinion Mining in Social Media and Online Newsfeeds for Forex Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Opinions hindered in social media, and online news feeds to control the predictability of financial markets such as Forex and cause huge profits and losses for the investors. Due to this reason, financial market prediction through opinion mining has gained significant attention from researchers recently. Current approaches relied more on basic text mining algorithms and overlooked the knowledge generated through the integration of the multiple data sources. To overcome this deficiency, this study harnesses the knowledge required for decisive currency-pair prediction by analyzing forex news and social media data using ensemble classification. Three classification approaches namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) are used in the ensemble classifier. Based on the classifier, impactful posts/comments are discovered to facilitate forex market prediction.

articleTitle: Design of Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna using Genetic Algorithm for Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper presents a design of single-fed circularly polarized patch antenna at 2.4 GHz-band for RF energy harvesting application. The irregular shaped patch is obtained by genetic algorithm optimization technique. The fitness function for circular polarization and return loss has reliably conflated in the genetic algorithm. The optimized irregular shaped single-fed microstrip patch antenna is designed using Matlab and HFSS software and the simulated result shows a return loss of -15.498 dB and the axial ratio of 2.09 dB at 2.41 GHz resonating frequency.

articleTitle: Cognitive Model for Object Detection based on Speech-to-Text Conversion
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to develop a model which is the integrated version of both SpeechRecognition and Object detection. This model is developed after undergoing the literature survey and the existing models that are related to Object Detection and Speech Recognition. There are several types of Speech Recognition and Object Detection models available so far. In addition to the existing models, this paper proposes a new model named "Cognitive Model for Object Detection based on Speech-to-Text Conversion," which is an integrated version of both Speech Recognition and Object Detection models. Firstly, A speech command is provided as an input to the model, it takes the command and processes the data, and then it detects the specified object from a source of images. The detected object is represented with a rectangular box. This approach is implemented with the help of Google Speech Recognition and YOLO object detection models utilizing the Darknet and OpenCV frameworks.

articleTitle: EmotionC: A Novel Framework for Emotion Detection Using Personalized Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In the days of the Modern era, searching or browsing through the Internet has been a part of our daily life. For example, if a person feels happy then he searches for a good movie or a song, if a person wants to commit suicide he searches the easy ways to commit suicide. The average person uses a browser for three to four times a day. So, detecting emotion by a person's search history could yield us the Emotional condition of a person. The existing search engines give us better results when the complete query is entered, hence it requires personalization to obtain better results with less input. In this paper, using ontology the users are segregated into different categories based on the emotion yielded. Also, each query is segregated into their respective category of emotion using clustering. Moreover, the privacy issue is addressed here by restricting the information only to the user profile. Finally, the user search history is tracked and based on the search history the emotion of a user will be detected.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Transmission System Expansion Planning in Deregulated Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Expansion of transmission system and its planning play an important role in power system operation and planning. An optimal configuration of network with the increase in load demand is possible using transmission system expansion planning (TSEP), so as to meet the demands of future at all consumption points. TSEP is a nonlinear problem with mixed integers whose objective function is to minimize the overall cost which includes investment, generation and load curtailment cost. Many techniques are proposed in literature to achieve global optimal solution with minimum number of iterations at less time. In this paper TSEP problem is solved by using interior point direct algorithm and branch and bound method. TSEP problem is tested on Garver’s 6-bus system and Brazilian network, to validate the proposed method. Simulation results will indicate the accuracy, efficiency and computation time of the solution technique.

articleTitle: A Quantitative approach to create a Hybrid stock filtering platform
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The world of investing and trading is vast and competitive, thus it is important to take into consideration multiple factors to gain an edge over other investors in order to be profitable. A stock screener is commonly used by investors and traders to filter stocks based on certain financial metrics. But to use these metrics available in the screener, one needs to have in depth knowledge to create a lucrative strategy. Attempting to use these metrics with lack of discipline and without taking into consideration multiple factors often leads to loss of hard earned money for novice investors. This problem is solved by creating a hybrid stock filtering system. The system is hybrid as it is created using a unique combination of fundamental, technical, machine learning and sentiment analysis. The users' of the platform can simply select from a list of hybrid strategies created that help in shortlisting of stocks. We aim to create a one-stop platform that beginner to experienced investors can use to filter out stocks. Apart from helping users' shortlist scrips through hybrid strategies, the entire procedure of data collection, cleaning, and visualization is automated. We demonstrate the complete methodology of our research along with in-depth explanations about our results and solutions to canvass the need of a hybrid stock filtering system for neophyte investors.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Simulation Virtual Online Guiding Resources based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Development and the analysis of simulation virtual online guiding resources based on VR technology is conducted in this paper. MR can easily complete human body modeling, as if it has a perspective eye, directly hitting the anatomical structure of the human body, and can interact with holographic images in real time through gestures, voice, peripherals, etc., and is in the theoretical study and practical exercise of general education both have positive and broad application prospects. In this research work, the face recognition, data mining and intelligent interaction models are combined to construct the efficient system. The experiment results have reflected the high accuracy and the core robustness. This proves the efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Code-Based Routing Using Distributed Approach for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Network coding is considered to be a reliable strategy for boosting the performance of wireless networks by injecting multiple packets into one transmission. It will provide performance improvement in turnout and energy potency. Network committal to writing was originally projected for wired networks. Recently there has been an impermanent version of network committal to writing that is mainly used to improve the performance of wireless networks. The sooner formula provided increased performance in Wireless Networks. But it possesses the bound set of limitations that incorporate the committal to writing chance depends on identified and finalized routes, and also the committal to writing structure is restricted. This article aims to overcome the problem mentioned above and to propose a competent method to be implemented. The associated automobile generative committal to writing technique will increase the performance by characterizing the possibility of codes and the impossibility of coding methods. Additionally, the projected method will sight committal to writing methods with the entire route. The projected method additionally provides the notion of the time delay to spot the trail and capable of examining the given two methods and choose the foremost effective one. It additionally provides a guarantee network committal to writing within the case of node failure. The projected method is used to analyze the victimization of the NS -2 package and also the performance remained productive.

articleTitle: Content based Video Retrieval using Improved Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix with Region-based Pre Convoluted Neural Network–RPCNN
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the improvement of sight and sound information types and transfer of accessible data capacity, there is a gigantic interest of video retrieval framework, as clients move from text based retrieval frameworks to content based retrieval framework. Choice of removing highlights assumes a significant part in the content based video retrieval paying some consideration to video credits. These highlights are planned for choosing, ordering and positioning as per their likely enthusiasm towards the client. This paper proposes an improved technique for feature extraction and classification using Improved GLCM (I-GLCM) with Region based pre convoluted neural network (R-PCNN). The simulation result shows the optimized accuracy, F-1 score, precision and recall as the parameters.

articleTitle: Effectual Cloud Storage Management based on De-duplication Techniques: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The expeditious growth of computer technology leads to data eruption which requires more storage space. Conventional backup takes much time to store the data and it does not have the capability to avert duplication. To enhance cloud storage efficiency, various solutions have been developed. Data de-duplication is one of the powerful approaches that play a crucial role in managing the storage space. De-duplication removes unnecessary data and reduces the cost of storage. This article reviews the different existing methods for eliminating repeated data using de-duplication.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Angular Frequency Selective Surface in Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Compact size angular frequency selective surface and the simulation analysis by improvised the dimensions of the unit cell of FSS is presented in this research work. The frequency selective surface has become a prerequisite for many applications such as satellite communication, Radar, Microwave, aircraft, and wireless communication. The proposed FSS unit cell design is a square patch type with 45-degree inclination and frequency of 4GHz to 11GHz. The intended FSS unit cell design consists of FR4 Epoxy substrate with dielectric constant 4.1666, at 7.2GHz. The proposed design is simulated and verified using ANSYS group HFSS 2018.2 software. The proposed model attains a minimum return loss of -29 dB with a bandwidth efficiency of 90% which is much better than conventional designs.

articleTitle: Qualitative Prediction and Recognition of ongoing Human Action Sequences Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Human action detection (HAD) is an important research area in the recent decades that can be applied in many applications such as security, gaming, virtual reality interfaces, surveillance systems, etc. The authors have used object detection algorithms with deep neural network-based classifiers in this experiment. Further, the proposed research work aims to explore the solutions for object detection in HAD. The model has been provided with a set of images, wherein each image, a person will be performing an activity such as standing, sitting, bending, waving, or sleeping. The label of an image will be the activity that is being performed in those images. The model will learn this relationship, and then it can predict the label of an input that it has never seen. The model is trained and tested with a dataset consisting of random images downloaded from the internet.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Design of E-learning Courses based on Instructional Model of SCO in MANET
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: E-learning plays vital role in the current scenario. Most of the learner given more interest towards the e-learning in the cyber world. This e-learning mainly focused on Sharable Content Object with an instructional model based on the Mobile Adhoc Network. This article deals with mainly four phases such as instructional based mode, sharable content object, e-learning course, and Mobile Adhoc Network. The instructional based modeact like providing instruction to the student or the mentor. The SCO Design is used to sharable content object based on the various resources dynamically. E-learning course is developed and implemented for the mentor and the learner. The learner can dynamically learn the course using Mobile Adhoc Network in the cyber world. The design of E-learning Courses based on Instructional Model of SCO is enchanced using MANET.
